name: NavTree
description: Grouped navigation branch: a labelled top-level entry (optionally navigable, optionally iconified) with indented subpage rows connected by tree connector lines. One NavTree renders one branch - compose it inside a list landmark such as NavList and mark the active row's anchor with aria-current=page. Connector lines are decorative web-only styling; React Native degrades to indentation.

root.description: List-item branch wrapping one group heading and its indented subpage list. Must sit inside a <ul>, e.g. NavList's list.

heading.description: Row pairing the optional icon with either the heading link or the static heading label.

icon.description: Optional decorative glyph preceding the heading text, rendered from the iconography catalog.

headingLink.description: Navigable heading rendered when href is provided.

headingLabel.description: Static heading rendered when href is absent.

list.description: Indented subpage list; connector lines run along its items.

item.description: Single subpage row. Consumer renders an <a> as the item's child and marks the active row's anchor with aria-current=page.

members.name: label
members.description: Heading text for the group. Rendered inside the heading link when href is provided, otherwise inside the static heading label.

members.name: href
members.description: When provided, the heading renders as a navigable <a> to this destination; when absent, the heading renders as a static label.

members.name: icon
members.description: Canonical icon name resolved against the @full-stack-ds/iconography catalog (e.g. "home"). An unknown name renders no glyph.

members.name: iconSize
members.description: Rendered size of the heading glyph.

focus.description: NavTree itself is not focusable. The heading link and the consumer's row anchors are native links that receive native tab focus.

usageHints: Compose one NavTree per group inside a list landmark such as NavList - the branch renders an <li> and must sit inside a <ul>.
Pass href to make the heading a navigable link; omit it to render a static heading label.
Render each subpage row as a NavTreeItem whose child is an <a>; mark the active row's anchor with aria-current="page".
One grouping level per instance. For deeper hierarchies, nest a further list inside a NavTreeItem (List-style composition).
Connector lines are decorative and web-only; React Native renders indentation without them.
